note: Two branches by academic status in one chunk (enrolled: paid by HYU; completed coursework: pays 25,000 won). Term from post date 2026-03-06.

chunk.title: Information on the private Insurance System for International Students
chunk.text:
Hanynag University operates a private insurance service for international students to prepare for unexpected accidents that may occur during their time in Korea.
Please note that the insurance subscription process varies depending on academic status at the beginning of each semester.
- Enrolled students : Premiums are paid in full through Hanyang University’s budget
(Students do not need to pay premiums themselves)
- Students who completed coursework : Students who wish to enroll in insurance, they must pay directly the premiun of 25,000 won themselves.
We recommend that students who completed coursework individually sign up for insurance by referring to the attached file.

note: National Health Insurance premium from March 1, 2026: a national rule, no campus procedure, no student constraint.

note: Report alien-registration changes within 14 days: immigration law for every foreign student.

chunk.title: Visa
chunk.text:
Application Period
Students must apply within 14 days from the date of any changes to the registration information below.
Change of name, gender, date of birth, or nationality
Change of passport number, issuance date, or expiration date
Change of school (including school name change)
New place of residence (new address may be registered at the local Gu District Office)
※ Failure to report the above changes within 14 days from the date of change may result in a fine.
